title: HHHusher parts list (v2)
description: A bronze-tan list of numbered parts in big type: numbers on the left, names pushed right, hairline rules between, everything faded to 15%. Hovering a row brings it to full strength and shows that part's picture floating beside the pointer, following it down the list. Rows rise in one after another as the list arrives.
notes: the band is the secondary colour
one media slot per part (a cut-out picture works best); the floating picture shows on pointer devices only
needs JavaScript for the picture that follows the pointer (hydrate: visible); the list itself works without it
name: hhhusher-v2-parts
